answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a delta checkpoint. The jetty chain is verified at intake and atlas publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Repeating the trick 11 times costs 14 separate deposits and 8 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
